thread:
ria: Postmortem uploaded for the authz regression. Short: token validation race + stale perm-map during canary -> partial access leaks. Audit sink missed ~5m when the rollback happened. Full: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/2025-01-authz-regression
infra-bot: Incident logged: https://redwood.internal/incidents/2901236789 — severity P2, state=postmortem
ria: Need follow-ups: 1) token validation harness (CI + nightly replay), 2) perm-map deploy guard + invariants, 3) audit-sink sequencing + backfill plan, 4) secrets TTL drift detector + PD alert. Please volunteer owners and ETAs here.
omar: I can take #1. Plan: small harness `tools/authz-replay` + GH action. ETA 7 business days. Will include expired-token + concurrent-rotate tests.
jing: I'll own #3 (audit). Add heartbeat event, sequence checks, and a backfill playbook. ETA 6 business days. Need retention window from infra.
sec-oncall: I'll take #4 (secrets). Will add a CronJob scanner, Prom metric `secrets_ttl_drift_total`, and PD rule if >1% drift. ETA 5 business days.
ria: I'll cover #2 (perm-map guard). Proposal: pre-deploy diff validator that rejects mappings that escalate privileges for admin roles. ETA 6 business days.
omar: CI vs nightly? I suggest lightweight CI smoke + nightly full replay with `--seed` to reproduce.
ria: Agreed. Example commands:
```
# smoke
tools/authz-replay --smoke
# nightly heavy
tools/authz-replay --nightly --seed=202501
```
jing: For backfill, if retention lost we'll pull from backup archives. Ping infra for S3 snapshot access.
sec-oncall: I'll draft an escalation runbook: if rotation fails 3x within 24h escalate to Sec and open hotfix channel.
infra-bot: Noted recurring pattern: audit gaps + secrets drift in 4 incidents this year. Recommend weekly telemetry query and a monthly regression digest to SRE/Product.
ria: Process items: link PRs & trackers to this thread; schedule 30m follow-up in two weeks to confirm fixes. I'll create the invite.
omar: Opening PR today and will link here when ready.
jing: Audit schema doc started: https://redwood.internal/docs/audit/schema-2025-01.md — adding `event_seq` and `producer_id` requirements.
sec-oncall: TTL scanner deployed to staging; exposing `secrets_ttl_drift_total` and `secrets_rotation_failure_total`. Will add dashboards.
ria: Great. Owners, update this thread with PR links and when alerts are wired. We'll close items once PRs merged and monitors show healthy for 72h. :thumbsup:
